download.download_private: Use a video that plays without signing in.
download.download_ytdlp_outdated: Meanwhile, upload the video file directly.
download.download_stalled: Create this project again in a few minutes.
download.download_failed: Check the link, then create this project again.

storage.storage_quota_exhausted: Download the clips you still need, then delete projects you no longer use.
storage.storage_free_space_low: Delete projects you no longer use.
storage.storage_admission_unavailable: Wait a moment, then try again.

llm.auth: Create a new key on the provider's site, then paste it in Settings.
llm.payment_required: Pick a free model with Get model list.
llm.quota_exhausted: Wait for the daily quota to reset, or add another free provider.
llm.rate_limited: Wait a moment, then run Test connection again.
llm.model_not_found: Press Get model list and pick an available model.
llm.context_too_small: Raise the Context limit (tokens), or lower Max answer tokens.
llm.network: Check the Base URL on the provider card.
llm.bad_json: Change that provider's JSON mode, then run Test connection.
llm.bad_response: Change that provider's JSON mode, then run Test connection.
llm.content_filter: Move another provider to the top, or pick another model.
llm.no_moments: Widen the minimum and maximum clip length in Create clips.
llm.missing_api_key: Get an API key on the provider's site, then paste it in Settings.
llm.not_free: Pick a free model with Get model list.
llm.config_invalid: Open Settings and fix the marked fields.
llm.unknown_provider: Open Settings and fix the marked fields.
llm.not_configured: Turn on AI in Settings and add a free provider.
